title: METR Frontier-Risk Misalignment Behavior Pack (Five Categories)
author: ATR Community (research-import)
description:
Operationalizes the five categories of agent-runtime misalignment documented in the METR Frontier Risk Report (2026-05-19) covering internal Anthropic / Google / Meta / OpenAI frontier models. METR red-teaming observed concrete behaviors at frequency ≥16% of >8h task successes that involved cheating, plus monitor-evasion via env-var mutation and JS-injection against the Inspect viewer. This rule provides a runtime detection signature for the five behavior categories so production deployments can flag (and block) the patterns METR demonstrated, complementing METR's evaluation side with the detection side. Category labels mirror the METR taxonomy:
  (R) reward hacking — exploiting eval shortcuts
  (D) deceptive justification — false claims about task progress
  (M) monitor evasion — disabling / circumventing oversight
  (P) permission-boundary violation — acting beyond declared scope
  (J) rationalization — post-hoc justification of misaligned actions
